name: Afrolicious Rhythm & Groove
description: Get ready to dance at the biggest Afro Party in Porto. The night is dedicated to the best of Afrobeat, Amapiano, and R&B.
longDescription:
Afrolicious Rhythm & Groove is a dedicated club night focusing on contemporary African and African-influenced music genres. The event centers on Afrobeat, Amapiano, and R&B, offering a curated selection of tracks within these styles. It aims to provide a consistent platform for these sounds within Porto's nightlife scene.

Attendees can expect an energetic atmosphere designed for dancing. The event takes place at Pinkclub, a venue known for its club nights. The music selection is continuous throughout the evening, encouraging sustained engagement on the dance floor. The audience typically comprises individuals interested in global music trends and dance culture.

Tickets for Afrolicious Rhythm & Groove are available starting from €9.76. Pinkclub is located in central Porto, within walking distance of Trindade metro station. Specific accessibility information for the venue is not provided. The event is scheduled to begin at 23:30 on May 23, 2026.
